sections.content: You know the future from A2 Unit 19, and *quizá* and *es posible que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 25. Combine them with *probablemente* to say how likely a prediction is.

items.english: There will probably be more changes.

items.spanish: Es posible que la sociedad sea diferente.
items.english: It is possible that society will be different.

items.spanish: Quizá la gente trabaje menos horas en el futuro.
items.english: Perhaps people will work fewer hours in the future.

sections.content: *Es posible que* and *quizá* take the subjunctive (*sea*, *trabaje*), but *probablemente* can sit in front of an ordinary future (*habrá*).
